data.narrative:
Last Energy, a Series C nuclear energy company founded by Bret Kugelmass, has raised $140M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, among them Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The stage-progression method is applicable here. Using total raised ($140M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x yields $238M. The peer-median method is not applicable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, insufficient clustering within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier valuation) prevents reliable median derivation without risking sector-wide dilution bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $202M (low) to $274M (high), with a median point of $238M. This triangulation rests on a single method, which constrains confidence. Key uncertainties include Last Energy's relative technology maturity versus the peer set, capital intensity trajectory through commercialization, and regulatory de-risking progress—data points not available in the current set. A peer-median cross-check would materially strengthen conviction once clustering criteria are satisfied.
